Tier.description:
The conformance tier a pack CLAIMS. Cumulative: each tier includes the ones before it. The
claim is checked by whoever owns that tier's check; a host may require a minimum.

- `declared`: the manifest validates (this package's reader).
- `loads`: the pack loads through the host's strict loader and registers exactly the keys its
  manifest `provides` (the loader's check).
- `conformant`: the pack passes the contract conformance kit.
Tier.title: Tier

description: One pack's declaration. Unknown keys are refused (`extra="forbid"`).

id.description: The pack's id: a slug, equal to its entry-point name in both groups.
id.title: Id

version.description: The pack's version. The reader holds it equal to the installed distribution's.
version.title: Version

contract.description: The contract MAJOR.MINOR the pack is written against. The host must speak the same MAJOR and at least this MINOR.
contract.title: Contract

tier.description: The conformance tier the pack claims (cumulative).

provides.description: Every key the pack registers, as kind -> names. A key registered and not declared, or declared and not registered, is a load failure.
provides.title: Provides

needs.description: Keys the host or another pack must provide, as kind -> names. A need nobody provides is a load failure.
needs.title: Needs

title.description: A display name. None = show the id.
title.title: Title

description.description: One paragraph on what the pack is for.
